facts.fact: Digital identity cards in Lesotho are listed among domestic eKYC frameworks that have financial services use cases (FinMark Trust, June 2026; no date for the use, published date used).

According to the Lesotho Ministry of Home Affairs, South Africa's Department of Home Affairs electronically verifies Lesotho citizens before issuing a Lesotho Exemption Permit (no date given; published date 2026-06-18 used).

systems.owner: South Africa Department of Home Affairs

LSO.note: Lesotho named also among countries lacking comprehensive e-transactions legislation.

MWI.note: Named as having, or building, a central bank-led or financial sector-led eKYC platform; checking against the national ID is not stated.

ZAF.note: Named as having or building a financial sector-led eKYC platform; checking against the South African ID is not stated. Its Home Affairs verifies Lesotho citizens, which is not use of its own ID.

ZMB.note: Named as having, or building, a central bank-led or financial sector-led eKYC platform; checking against the national ID is not stated.

ZWE.note: Named only as lacking comprehensive data protection or e-transactions legislation.
